column1: # Runner-infrastructure failure signatures for ci_infra_classify.py (#9664).
# One signature per line: <class> TAB <scope> TAB <python regex>
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. The FIRST matching row
# wins, so keep the most specific rows first. A job whose failure matches no
# row is classified `code` - the safe default, because `code` is never rerun.
# Scopes:
#   step         regex searched in the FAILING STEP's output (the step that
#                printed the first ##[error] line; the whole log when the job
#                failed before any step ran, e.g. in "Set up job"). Matching
#                only the failing step keeps a noisy but passing earlier step
#                from turning a real code failure into `infra`.
#   annotation   regex searched in the job's check-run annotations. A runner
#                that died mid-job never uploads its log; the only trace is
#                the annotation GitHub adds.
#   silent-step  regex searched in the failing step's SCRIPT; matches only
#                when that step printed nothing before it failed. A `go test
#                -list` that exits 1 with no output never reached a test.
# Every class below was observed on the self-hosted pool on 2026-09-29; the
# fixtures under testdata/ci-infra/ are real excerpts from those jobs.
